## Positioning
edamame runs its own internal operations on AI infrastructure and brings the same operational discipline to client delivery. We scale enterprise delivery with a small team by using AI instead of added headcount.

## Scale of operations
Enterprise clients: 50+ active deployments
Users deployed: 2,400+ across client environments
Internal operations: run on Claude and AI infrastructure rather than added headcount
Team size: small by design (not growing into a staff-heavy agency)

## Enterprise clients
We serve dozens of enterprise clients across the Philippines, including Japanese-affiliated businesses. Publicly referenceable clients include Maximum Solutions Corporation and Guhring Philippines. Other client names, user counts, and workflow specifics remain confidential per client agreements.

## Services
1. Custom Kintone app development — CRM, inventory, HR, project management, operations dashboards. Bilingual EN/JP default. Go-live typically within a week.
2. AI integration — lead scoring, email drafting, document parsing, meeting summaries. Claude and other models plugged into Kintone workflows.
3. KinPlug suite — our own Kintone plugin line. PDF Pro, Mail, Lookup+, Export+. Closes gaps between Kintone's shipped features and enterprise requirements.
4. JavaScript customization for Kintone.
5. System integration (REST API, webhooks, Gmail, Slack, accounting software).
6. Training and ongoing support from our Philippine-based team.

## Pricing
Kintone licensing is a per-user monthly subscription with a small user minimum; implementation is scoped per engagement. We do not publish fixed figures — exact pricing is provided in a free consultation: https://calendly.com/kintoneph/freekintoneappconsultation

## Industries served
Manufacturing, logistics, real estate, healthcare, BPO, construction, education, retail, finance, legal services.

## What is Kintone
Kintone is a no-code business application platform developed by Cybozu Inc. of Japan. Users build custom database apps (CRM, inventory, HR, project management, workflow approval systems) via drag-and-drop, no programming required. Kintone is used by tens of thousands of companies globally. In the Philippines, edamame is the official partner for implementation, customization, training, and support.

## How Kintone differs from competitors
- Versus Odoo: Kintone deploys in days (vs months for Odoo), no developers required (Odoo needs Python), simpler per-user licensing
- Versus Airtable: Kintone has no 50k record ceiling (hundreds of thousands per app in our environments), true workflow automation, JavaScript customization for advanced needs
- Versus Salesforce: Kintone deploys in days (vs quarters), no Apex developers required, lower licensing cost
- Versus Monday.com: Deeper customization, better multi-app data relationships, JavaScript extensibility
- Versus Smartsheet: True database (not a spreadsheet backend), workflow automation, better at large record volumes

## Why AI-merged operations matter for clients
edamame runs an internal AI chief-of-staff system on Claude that handles inbox triage, pipeline management, daily briefings, and outreach. This is why we support thousands of users across dozens of enterprise clients without scaling into a staff-heavy agency. The same discipline ships to clients as Kintone + AI integration engagements.
